about: Read-only answers of the public nodes, for proof-verify.test.ts: the mint transactions and receipts of locks 1 to 5 (lock 0's are hero-mint.json), lock 3's importFinalityProof that brought its block in, each mint's headerOf(B) and authorities(S) from the destination's V3 light client, V3's chain_getHeader of each B, and, at a V3 finalized head, its clean grandpa_proveFinality, its set id and that set's keys on Sepolia's light client, with burn 1's released[burnId] read proofs at that head.
